title: Check the health of a live product
summary: When you take over a live product, check how it is really doing: usage, quality, reliability, costs and user satisfaction.

beginner: Find the dashboards and ask what each number means.
Look at usage trends over the last year.
Check reliability, incidents and support volumes.
Write a short health summary with the top three concerns.
intermediate: Review usage, quality, reliability and cost.
experienced: Compare health with goals and peers.
Find the biggest opportunities and risks.
Use the summary to set your first priorities.

toolExamples.jira: Review recent incidents and support tickets.

definitionOfDone: Usage, quality, reliability and cost reviewed
pitfalls: Trusting dashboards without asking how they work

sources.title: Measuring the user experience on a large scale: the HEART framework (Google Research)
